        int numerator = 1;
        int denominator = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= r; i++) {
            numerator *= (n - i + 1);
            denominator *= i;
        }
        return numerator / denominator;

        int b = ncr(x, 2) * ncr(n - x, 1);
        int c = ncr(x, 1) * ncr(n - x, 2);
        double totalWays = ncr(n, 3);
        return ((3.0 / 6) * c + b + a) / totalWays;
    }
}
